en.name: GeoGebra Graphing

tools.name: ggb_eval
tools.description: Execute GeoGebra commands in the graphing panel (e.g. "f(x)=sin(x)", "g(x)=x^2/4", "A=Intersect(f,g,1)", "SetColor(f,\"Blue\")"). The panel opens automatically. Returns per-command success and the names of all objects.

commands.description: GeoGebra command strings, executed in order

tools.name: ggb_clear
tools.description: Remove all objects from the GeoGebra panel (start a new construction).

tools.name: ggb_export_png
tools.description: Export the current GeoGebra view as a PNG (shown to the user as a downloadable image). Returns the byte size.
